title: qabeenya of tuulummaa jalatti lixe
intro: Mee tuullaa qabeenya baayʼee balʼaa taʼee fi furtuu sana baachuu qofti garee namoota ciccimoo taʼan tokko akka dadhabsiisu dura dhaabachuu kee yaadi. Naannoo keetti sagaleewwan gad of qabuu fi yaadannoo kan kakaasan siʼa taʼu, galata caalaa of tuuluun ni guddata. Yeroo badhaasni qormaata ta’ee of tuuluun bu’aa isaa irratti chaappaa godhu maaltu ta’a?
clues: Ani ummata Muusaa keessaa ture, ta’us isaan irratti daddarbe.
Qabeenyi baayʼee guddaa taʼee fi furtuuwwan isaanii garee namoota ciccimoo taʼaniif baʼaa akka taʼu naaf kenname.
Akkan hin gammadin, qooda adunyaa irraa koo osoo hin dagatin Aakhira akkan barbaadu ummata kiyyaan gorfame.
Wanti ani qabu beekumsa ani qabu qofaaf akka naaf kenname himadhe.
Faayaan saba koo duratti nan parade, warri jireenya addunyaa hawwan immoo waanan qabu kana fakkaatu hawwu turan.
Bakka jireenyaa koo wajjin lafaan liqimfame, namni na gargaaruu hin dandeenye, of gargaaruus hin dandeenye.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
